setup.baseUrl: Type the base URL WITH /v1 (e.g. http://localhost:8787/v1) in both. Cline: AI SDK strips trailing slashes then appends /chat/completions; Roo Code: the openai SDK appends /chat/completions to the base URL as typed. Model list uses `{baseUrl}/models` in both.
setup.model: Cline: Settings > API Provider 'OpenAI Compatible' > Model ID (free text, also offered from /models). Roo Code: API Provider 'OpenAI Compatible' > Model (free text/dropdown). Use the agent name, e.g. agent/sample.
setup.apiKey: API Key field; sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Cline omits the header if empty; Roo sends 'Bearer not-provided' if empty.
setup.notes: Evidence is for two different request stacks: CLINE (VS Code extension 4.1.x, CLI and SDK) now routes OpenAI-Compatible through the Vercel AI SDK `@ai-sdk/openai-compatible` (strict zod stream parsing, no X-Stainless-*), whereas ROO CODE (archived 2026-05-15, last release 3.54.0) still uses the `openai` npm SDK. Case ids are prefixed cline-/roo-. Requests are made from the local extension host, so localhost gateways are reachable. Roo Code is discontinued; keep its cases as legacy regression coverage.

cases.title: Cline: GET {baseUrl}/models (settings panel model dropdown refresh)

evidence.note: Sent by the extension host with axios (not the AI SDK). Base URL has trailing slashes stripped first. Any error, non-JSON or missing `data` array silently yields an empty list (the user can still type a model id by hand).

cases.notes: Reads `response.data?.data?.map(m => m.id)` and de-duplicates; no other field is read. Authorization is omitted when the API key is empty. Custom headers from provider settings are added. axios default Accept/User-Agent shown are assumptions about axios defaults (version not pinned).

cases.title: Cline: agent turn, streaming (always carries tools; tool_choice 'auto'; stream_options always)

evidence.note: Request keys verified from @ai-sdk/openai-compatible 3.0.67 getArgs/doStream with Cline's createOpenAICompatible({includeUsage:true, transformRequestBody}). tool_choice 'auto' is injected by the `ai` package whenever tools exist (prepareToolChoice default). max_tokens is synthesized by Cline's gateway: min(max(32000, 0.3*model.maxOutputTokens), model.contextWindow(128000 fallback) - estimatedInputTokens - 1024), so it varies per request.

cases.notes: Headers come from @ai-sdk/openai-compatible (Vercel AI SDK), NOT the openai npm SDK: Content-Type, Authorization (only if an API key is set), and a User-Agent built as 'ai-sdk-openai-compatible/<ver> ai-sdk-provider-utils/<ver> <runtime>'. No Accept, no X-Stainless-*, no HTTP-Referer/X-Title (those Cline identity headers are only added for the first-party `cline` providers, request-headers.ts L45-L102). User-defined custom headers (Cline setting `openAiHeaders`) are merged in. Exact version numbers vary with the installed packages; whether the `ai` package also appends an 'ai/<ver>' UA suffix was not found in stream-language-model-call.ts. Tool name/description/schema are illustrative (Cline's real tool set was not enumerated). Wrapper keys are verified from prepareTools: {type:'function', function:{name, description, parameters}} and `strict` only if the tool sets it. STRICT stream parsing (zod): every chunk must have a `choices` array (empty [] is fine for the usage chunk); delta.role, if present, must be 'assistant' or ''; tool_call deltas must have a `function` object; at least one chunk must carry a non-null finish_reason or the stream is reported as an error ('Response stream ended without a finish reason'). [DONE] is optional. A chunk with a top-level `error` is treated as an error part. Unknown extra fields are allowed (looseObject). temperature is sent only if Cline sets one (default not traced) and is omitted here; no top_p/penalties/seed/stop are ever set by Cline.

evidence.note: Body keys verified from OpenAiHandler.createMessage. tool_choice 'auto' and parallelToolCalls true are set in Task.ts for the main loop; temperature defaults to 0 for this provider (getModel defaultTemperature 0); max_tokens/max_completion_tokens are NOT sent unless 'Include max output tokens' is on. User content arrays (several text blocks) are an inference from Roo storing Anthropic-style content blocks; convertToOpenAiMessages passes string content through and arrays through as parts.

cases.notes: Headers: `openai` npm SDK (package.json requires ^5.12.2; header builder read at v5.23.2) plus Roo DEFAULT_HEADERS (HTTP-Referer, X-Title, and a User-Agent 'RooCode/<ext version>' that overrides the SDK's 'OpenAI/JS'), plus any user-defined custom headers. Authorization is 'Bearer not-provided' when no API key is entered. X-Stainless-* values vary per machine. Roo post-processes every non-MCP tool schema: function.strict=true, all properties forced into `required`, additionalProperties:false, nullable types flattened (base-provider.ts L27-L106). MCP tools (names with the 'mcp--' prefix) keep their own schema with strict:false. Tool names/descriptions here are illustrative. Stream parsing is the openai SDK: [DONE] optional, delta.role not read, finish_reason only compared with 'tool_calls' to close tool calls (tool_call_end), usage read from any chunk that has `usage` (a final chunk with choices:[] is fine), `choices?.[0]` tolerant of an empty array. `<think>...</think>` tags inside delta.content are split into reasoning, and delta.reasoning_content is surfaced as reasoning. stream_options is dropped only when the base URL host contains 'x.ai'.
